title: Insurance Consultant
description:

 Bajaj Life Insurance is one of India’s fastest\-growing life insurance providers, offering a broad portfolio of products including ULIPs, term plans, retirement, and child policies to support long\-term financial security and life goals. With over 3\.47 crore policyholders, strong assets under management, a high claim settlement ratio, and robust solvency margins, the company is positioned as a trusted partner for protection and wealth creation. Day\-to\-day tasks include learning about Bajaj Life’s product suite, supporting senior consultants with customer interactions, maintaining accurate records of conversations, and escalating complex issues to experienced team members when needed. * Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge

 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

**About Gintaa** 




 At Gintaa, were redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. **Role Overview**

 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager**

 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**
